goal.title: Ship the slug CLI

Preserve .envmux.json unchanged. Make the actual source executable and finish the full goal. Do not stop at a proposal.

tasks.title: Build and document the POSIX shell slug CLI with focused tests
tasks.description: Create bin/slug.sh using a /bin/sh shebang and standard shell tools only, with no Node, Python, or packages. Use LC_ALL=C for deterministic ASCII normalization and printf for safe argument handling. Require exactly one argument; invalid argument counts should print usage to stderr and exit 2. Normalize ASCII uppercase to lowercase, replace each run of non-ASCII-letter/digit characters with one hyphen, trim boundary hyphens, and print the result with a newline. If normalization produces nothing, print a clear error to stderr and exit 2 without stdout. Make the actual source executable and preserve its executable Git mode. Create tests/slug.test.sh using shell assertions that invoke the executable directly and verify output, exit status, and stderr for normal text, Hello__World!!, mixed case, repeated separators, boundary separators, digits, whitespace-only, punctuation-only, empty input, and invalid argument counts. Expand the existing minimal README.md with invocation examples, the ASCII normalization contract, exit status 2 for empty results, and bash tests/slug.test.sh. Preserve .envmux.json byte-for-byte. Run the listed checks, fix failures, and deliver all code, tests, and documentation integrated into the repository.
